problem_statement: Add a RIOT package named tinyvcdiff that decodes interleaved VCDIFF deltas. It must provide vcdiff.h with vcdiff_t, vcdiff_init, vcdiff_set_source_driver, vcdiff_set_target_driver, vcdiff_apply_delta, and vcdiff_finish. The API should support usage such as vcdiff_init(&vcdiff); vcdiff_set_source_driver(&vcdiff, &vcdiff_mtd_driver, &source); vcdiff_set_target_driver(&vcdiff, &vcdiff_mtd_driver, &target); vcdiff_apply_delta(&vcdiff, delta_bin, delta_bin_len); vcdiff_finish(&vcdiff). A successful vcdiff_apply_delta followed by vcdiff_finish must reconstruct the target from the source and delta. It must also provide vcdiff_mtd.h with vcdiff_mtd_t, VCDIFF_MTD_INIT, and vcdiff_mtd_driver, and vcdiff_vfs.h with vcdiff_vfs_t, VCDIFF_VFS_INIT, and vcdiff_vfs_driver. The MTD backend must read source data from and write reconstructed data to an mtd_dev_t, and the VFS backend must read source data from and write reconstructed data to an open file.
